listening.title: Suggesting a bigger plan to a happy customer

lines.speaker: Hoa (Account Manager)
lines.text: Good morning, Mr. Khanh. Thank you for the call. How is the system working for your team?

lines.speaker: Mr. Khanh (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Quite well. We now have twenty people using it every day, not eight.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Account Manager)
lines.text: That is good news. I saw the report, and your team has much heavier usage than before.

lines.speaker: Mr. Khanh (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Yes, and sometimes the system asks us to remove old files. It is a bit annoying.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Account Manager)
lines.text: That happens when the plan is full. If you step up to the business plan, you get more storage.

lines.speaker: Mr. Khanh (Operations Manager)
lines.text: How much more would we pay for that?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Account Manager)
lines.text: About two million dong a month. It also unlocks extra features like advanced reports.

lines.speaker: Mr. Khanh (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Reports could help. My director asks for numbers every Monday.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Account Manager)
lines.text: Then it is worth considering. The delivery module also pairs well with what you use now.

lines.speaker: Mr. Khanh (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Two things at once? That sounds expensive for this quarter.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Account Manager)
lines.text: If you take both, we can offer a bundle discount. But I only want the option that fits your needs.

lines.speaker: Mr. Khanh (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Fair enough. Send me the prices and a success story, and I will discuss it with my director.
